title: Identify
subtitle: Identify, diagnose, and ask questions about your plants with AI
identifyCardSubtitle: Take a photo and find out what plant it is
diagnosisCardSubtitle: Take a photo and get an AI diagnosis right away
specialistIntro: Ask about any plant or care topic — it doesn't have to be one of yours.
faqDiagnoseQuestion: How does the AI diagnosis work?
faqDiagnoseAnswer: In the Identify tab, tap "Diagnose my plant" and take a photo. The AI analyzes the image: whether the plant is healthy, what might be wrong and what to do next. Each diagnosis costs {{count}} credits and is saved to your history.
faqIdentifyAnswer: In the Identify tab, tap "Identify a plant" and take a close-up photo of a leaf or flower, or pick one from your gallery. The AI recognizes the species and suggests a care profile for you to review before saving.
faqCareQuestion: Where do the light, temperature, and humidity values come from?
faqCareAnswer: After identification, we ask an AI about the species (watering, light, temperature, toxicity, and trivia) and fill in the fields automatically. You can adjust any value before saving — these numbers guide the plant's care.
faqSunAnswer: It's a more intuitive way to show the ideal amount of light, in 5 levels: from 1 sun (shade) to 5 suns (full sun). The more suns, the more direct light the plant needs.
faqWateringAnswer: When you add the plant, you set how many days apart it needs water. We create the watering reminder automatically, and it shows up again in your reminders whenever the cycle repeats.
faqDeleteQuestion: How do I delete a plant?
faqDeleteAnswer: Open the plant, tap the options menu (⋮) at the top of the screen and choose "Delete plant". This deletes the plant and all reminders linked to it, and it cannot be undone.
faqSyncQuestion: Are my plants saved in the cloud?
faqSyncAnswer: Yes! Everything is saved to your account, so you can switch devices without losing your garden.
